author: Hudson Hongo
description:
When we need medical care, we expect decisions about our treatment to be made by our doctors, not a tech company's algorithm. But in January, the federal government launched a program that uses AI to evaluate Medicare beneficiaries' requests for certain procedures.

EFF sued for records on WISeR, seeking badly needed transparency about Medicare's AI experiment. In our latest EFFector newsletter, we're talking about what happens when the government outsources treatment approval to private AI companies—without sufficient transparency, testing, or legal limits.
